About

Thirteen Years of Turning Operations into Outcomes

From the ground up to Multi-Region leadership: a career built on hands on troubleshooting, now leading Multi-Region Delivery for an enterprise client, grounded in ITSM discipline and increasingly shaped by AI Powered Transformation.

As IT Service Delivery Manager at Tata Consultancy Services, I oversee End User Computing and Onsite Support Operations for a major pharmaceutical and biotechnology client. My work spans Service Delivery, Stakeholder Management and Vendor & Commercial Governance with a growing focus on designing AI Agents and building Copilot, Claude and Gemini powered workflows that make delivery teams faster and leaner.

ITIL v4 and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certified with the last two years spent continuously deepening expertise in Agentic AI Architecture, Microsoft Copilot Administration and Enterprise AI Transformation and now drive AI capability building across teams as a Gen AI Trainer.
